items.title: 68239_Ram Ramirez oral history interview
items.q: I had asked Walter to do the lyric on 'Lover Man'

ctx.x: Well, I mean, she was a child at heart. But I have a witness to that. Walter saw (?). He just couldn't get over that.

And of course, at that time... To go on with my story... I had asked Walter to do the lyric on "Lover Man" because it... "I go to bed with a prayer" and all that; you know, in those days it was a no-no. "You'll make love to me" -- it was very earthy in those days.
